pages.title: BotHearth — your AI agent, with a computer
pages.description: Give BotHearth a task. Your AI agent browses websites, works with files, and saves results for you to review. Watch it work and take control when it needs you.

pages.title: Get BotHearth — set up your AI agent and run a first task
pages.description: Set up BotHearth on a Mac or Linux computer, connect your model account, and run your first task. This alpha installs from source with Node.js and Docker.

pages.title: How BotHearth works — give it a task, watch it work
pages.description: Describe a task, follow your agent’s computer, review requests, and open the files it saves. Learn how to connect your model and take control when needed.

pages.title: BotHearth security and privacy — where your data goes
pages.description: Read BotHearth's container, approval, and human-control boundaries; what remote models receive; how task data is retained; and how to report a vulnerability.

pages.title: What BotHearth can do — tasks to try with your AI agent
pages.description: Ask BotHearth to research a topic, compare options from pages you provide, or summarize a personal reading log. Try a prompt and open the result it saves.

pages.title: BotHearth FAQ — licence, costs, compatibility, and limits
pages.description: Is BotHearth free? What does the usage meter measure? Which platforms work? Clear answers about PolyForm Noncommercial, model costs, and the alpha release.

pages.title: About BotHearth — project, author, and contribution guide
pages.description: Meet BotHearth, an AI agent with its own computer, maintained by Sanjay Bhat. Try a task, explore the source, and help improve the project.

pages.title: BotHearth for enterprises — one free perpetual licence per organisation
pages.description: Verify your work email to claim one free perpetual BotHearth licence for internal business use. Contact Sanjay Bhat for additional installations.

pages.title: BotHearth commercial terms — US$99 perpetual installation licences
pages.description: Business licence terms for BotHearth: US$99 per additional installation, one-time payment, internal use, email delivery, and clear alpha software limits.

pages.title: BotHearth refund and cancellation policy — one-time licence purchases
pages.description: BotHearth paid licence sales are final with no voluntary refunds. Read cancellation rules, billing-error support, and mandatory legal and payment-provider exceptions.
